title: Agent chat
description: One stateless turn on the current published version of the agent, or, with `target` `candidate`, on a preview of the agent's current candidate. Instructions, model (a catalogue entry with its provider connection), collections, retrieval depth, MCP tools, terminal tools, response schema and sampling come from the version; a body key that sets one of them (`connection`, `provider`, `model`, ...) is rejected with 422.

target.title: Target
target.description: Which configuration answers. `published` (default): the agent's current published version; an agent without one is rejected with 422. `candidate` (requires the permission `neuronai:agent:chat_candidate`, otherwise 403): a preview of the agent's current candidate, validated like a publish (an invalid candidate is rejected with 422 at `candidate/<field>`), frozen as a preview version and reused while the candidate is unchanged; the response's `agentVersion` then points at that preview and `agentVersionKind` is `preview`. A disabled agent is rejected with 422 for both.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: The conversation so far as a list of `{role, content}` objects with role `user` or `assistant`. The last entry is the user message of this turn and must not be empty, the earlier ones are the history. Nothing is stored; send the whole list with every request.

variables.title: Variables
variables.description: Values of the `{{name}}` placeholders in the version's instructions, validated against the version's `startSchema`; scalar values only. `date`, `language` and `agentName` are system values and cannot be supplied. A variable the version does not declare, an invalid value or a placeholder left unfilled answers 422 at `variables/<name>`.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language tag of the instructions, one of the version's `languages`; omitted: the version's `defaultLanguage`. Without an instructions text for the tag the text of the default language applies. Another tag answers 422.

maxToolCalls.title: Max tool calls
maxToolCalls.description: Tool calls the model may make before it is forced to answer. May only lower the bound of the version (or of the application and bundle defaults); a higher value is clamped to it. Null or omitted: the resolved bound.
